srs.explanation: LearnSphere uses spaced repetition (a simplified SM-2 method). After each card you rate how well you remembered it: Forgot brings it back tomorrow, Hard grows the gap slowly, Medium grows it normally, Easy grows it faster. Cards you know well come back less often, so your time goes to what you're about to forget.
srs.intervalHelp: Below 100% shows cards more often (better retention, more reviews). Above 100% spaces them out.
srs.premiumOnly: Free plan: up to {{newCards}} new cards and {{reviews}} reviews per day with standard intervals. Premium lets you tune these.
